ThreadActions.note: Open menu anchored under its trigger: label, separators, grouped items with icons, DropdownMenuShortcut on the right, and a destructive item in the destructive ink. Popover frame and radius are the DS ones.

CheckboxItems.note: Checked/unchecked/disabled checkbox items all visible — the indicator check only paints on the two checked rows, so the state axis actually varies.

RadioItems.note: Radio group with the filled circle indicator on the selected model row; label + three real model names.

WithSubmenu.note: Sub-panel renders anchored to the right of the highlighted sub-trigger (needs the portal + a deferred open — see learnings). Chevron, highlight state, and a disabled item on the parent menu all render.
